fields.sql: UPDATE shift_slot SET name = :name, start_time = :start_time::time, end_time = :end_time::time, headcount = :headcount::smallint, required_role_tags = string_to_array(NULLIF(:required_role_tags, ''), ',')::text[], min_seniority = NULLIF(:min_seniority, '')::smallint, display_order = COALESCE(NULLIF(:display_order, '')::smallint, display_order), updated_at = now() WHERE id = :id::uuid AND tenant_id = '{{ Current User.shiftyTenantId }}'::uuid RETURNING id
